item.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal paid a courtesy call on H.S.H. Hereditary Prince Alois of Liechtenstein on 28 October 2026 during his State Visit to India. The meeting focused on strengthening economic engagement and advancing investment opportunities under the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
item.title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Meets H.S.H. Hereditary Prince Alois of Liechtenstein
